### The Greatest Joy You Can Experience
Author: Dr. Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-june-6-2011.html
Passage: Psalm 71:17-18
Points:
- Welcoming children moves parents to prayer and rededicating their lives to God.
- A godly parent's highest desire is seeing their children trust their Savior.
- Watching children walk in truth provides the greatest joy in life.
- Believers must actively proclaim God's power and share Jesus with the next generation.

### Why Sing?
Author: Mike DeVries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-aug-29-2007-11552625.html
Passage: Psalm 71:22-24
Points:
- Singing praise is a central, unifying practice across all Christian gatherings.
- Believers sing spontaneously out of genuine celebration and joy.
- Singing serves as an essential discipline of hope during painful circumstances.
- Hymns and songs connect believers to a greater reality and generations of worshipers.
